intro.name: The trial
intro.text: Researchers compete to identify unknown powders, separate harmless mixtures, make useful dyes, and explain the changes they observe. The healers forbid tasting unknown substances or making dangerous fumes.

choices.label: Reward the clearest explanation and safest method.

a1.text: A contestant produces a durable plant dye that transforms village weaving.

text_only.what: tech, food, or appropriate skill experience
text_only.reason: the trial names no villager to gain skill; this trial's constructive success gives tech

a2.text: An apparent failure yields a surprisingly effective clay sealant. The judges argue whether accidents count as discoveries.

text_only.what: tech, food, or appropriate skill experience
text_only.reason: the trial names no villager to gain skill; this trial's constructive success gives tech

a3.text: A pompous researcher makes a foul-smelling paste. The crowd retreats, and the judges award no prize.

b1.text: A careful apprentice identifies a mislabeled mineral before anyone uses it. The healers declare (apprentice.him/her) the true champion.

p1.text: A judge from the other community praises the winning rival despite pressure from (judge.his/her) own supporters. The crowd slowly applauds.

p2.text: An accusation of favoritism forces the judges to disclose their criteria; the disputed result is upheld, reversed, or declared a tie.

p3.text: Competitors from both communities secretly practice together and publicly acknowledge each other when the results are announced.
